info.name: Handwrite.io API
info.description:
Postman collection for the Handwrite.io API (v1).

**Base URL:** `https://api.handwrite.io/v1`

**Authentication:** All requests require an `Authorization` header set to your API key. Keys begin with `test_hw` (testing) or `live_hw` (production).

**Rate limit:** 60 requests/minute. Exceeding returns HTTP 429. Rate-limit info is returned in the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

Docs: https://documentation.handwrite.io/

request.description: Returns the list of available handwriting styles for your account. Use a returned `_id` as the `handwriting` value when sending a letter.
Returns the list of available stationery/cards for your account. Use a returned `_id` as the `card` value when sending a letter.

request.description:
Sends one or more handwritten letters.

**Required fields:** `message` (max 320 chars), `handwriting` (ID), `card` (ID), `recipients` (array of 1-10 recipient objects).

**Recipient required fields:** `street1`, `city`, `state` (2-letter, capitalized), `zip` (5-digit). Optional: `firstName`, `lastName`, `company`, `street2`.

**Optional `from` object:** return address (`firstName`, `lastName`, `street1`, `street2`, `city`, `state`, `zip`).

**Batch mode:** the endpoint also accepts an array of message objects (max 1,000 orders per request).

request.description:
Retrieves a single order by its ID.

**URL param:** `orderId` (set the `orderId` collection variable).

**Status values:** `processing`, `written` (not yet delivered), `complete` (mailed), `problem` (technical issue), `cancelled`.
